title: Create multiple partitions on a disk
summary: Reformat a disk and create several partitions at once, specifying the filesystem, name, and size for each one.

steps.explain: Reformat the disk and create the specified number of partitions, providing details for each.

placeholders.name: DISK_DEVICE
placeholders.description: The identifier of the disk to partition.

placeholders.name: NUMBER_OF_PARTITIONS
placeholders.description: The total number of partitions to create.

placeholders.name: PARTITION_SCHEME
placeholders.description: The partition scheme: APM, MBR, or GPT.

warnings: This command will erase all existing data on the disk.
Ensure the sum of partition sizes does not exceed the disk capacity.
Verify the disk identifier carefully before running.

rollback.explain: Data erased by this command cannot be recovered using standard tools. Restore from a backup if available.
